definitions.explanation: The process of becoming colder, used especially in discussions of climate and environmental change.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寒冷化|かんれいか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
⟦{氷河期|ひょうがき}→氷河期：13445_hyougaki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大規模|だいきぼ}→大規模：12185_daikibo⟧な{寒冷化|かんれいか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: Large-scale cooling occurred during the ice ages.

examples.japanese: ⟦{火山|かざん}→火山：04020_kazan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{噴火|ふんか}→噴火：00045_funka⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{大気|たいき}→大気：03388_taiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一時的|いちじてき}→一時的：05846_ichijiteki⟧な{寒冷化|かんれいか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{起|お}こす→引き起こす：06165_hikiokosu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Changes in the atmosphere from volcanic eruptions can cause temporary cooling.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{寒冷|かんれい}→寒冷：19667_kanrei⟧ (cold) + ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (transformation; -ification). The ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ suffix indicates a process of change, so {寒冷化|かんれいか} literally means the process of becoming cold. Used primarily in scientific, environmental, and news contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧{寒冷化|かんれいか}: global cooling
- {寒冷化|かんれいか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: cooling advances
- ⟦{急激|きゅうげき}→急激：02633_kyuugeki⟧な{寒冷化|かんれいか}: rapid cooling
- {寒冷化|かんれいか}⟦{現象|げんしょう}→現象：02718_genshou⟧: cooling phenomenon

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{温暖化|おんだんか}→温暖化：04622_ondanka⟧: warming — the opposite process; ⟦{地球温暖化|ちきゅうおんだんか}→地球温暖化：18873_chikyuuondanka⟧ (global warming) is the far more commonly discussed topic
- ⟦{冷却|れいきゃく}→冷却：09796_reikyaku⟧: cooling; refrigeration — refers to active, deliberate cooling (of a machine, liquid, etc.) rather than a natural climate shift
- ⟦{寒冷|かんれい}→寒冷：19667_kanrei⟧: cold; frigid — the base adjective describing cold conditions, without the process implied by ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧
